'''Commbuzzers''' were a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[biot]] that were agitated by [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] signals. Before their development during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] could be finalized, the [[Shaper caste|shapers]]' nest that was creating them was [[Mission to Chashima|infiltrated]] and destroyed by [[Wraith Squadron]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="XWMK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
